name: Pictor
description: The Painter's Easel is a small southern constellation introduced by Nicolas-Louis de Lacaille in the 1750s. It contains Beta Pictoris, a young star surrounded by a vast debris disk seen nearly edge-on, and PSR J0437-4715, the nearest and most precisely timed millisecond pulsar to Earth.
funFact: PSR J0437-4715 rotates 174 times per second and is so stable that it rivals atomic clocks in precision. Arrays of millisecond pulsars like this one are used as a 'pulsar timing array' — a galaxy-scale gravitational wave detector sensitive to nanohertz waves from supermassive black hole mergers.
